_comment: FitBot evaluation cases. Expected numbers are for the sample profile in fitbot-ask.mjs (male, 180 cm, 90 kg, 30 y, moderate activity, goal 80 kg at moderate pace, strength training) with nothing eaten: BMR 1880, TDEE 2914, targets 2414 kcal / protein 162 g / carbs 291 g / fat 67 g, BMI 27.8. `mustMatch`: every regex must match. `mustNotMatch`: none may match. Regexes are case-insensitive.

cases.question: What is my daily calorie target?
How much protein should I eat per day?
What is my daily fat target in grams?

What is my TDEE (maintenance calories)?
